stage: development (stage 4: naturalness of the sketch-silhouette model), not held-out; same 8 dev scenes as stages 1-3

silhouette_parser.note: Masks are parsed from each instance sketch only (stroke-end bridging, closing, hole fill); no oracle or dataset masks. Polygon sampling follows upstream sample_sparse_points_from_mask, made deterministic.

layout_only_rule: Silhouette masks and polygons condition the n+1 MIS layout trajectories (first int(50*0.36)=18 of 50 PLMS steps); after the merge the joint trajectory keeps boxes, centre points and phrases only (UniFusion test_drop_masks). Fixed a priori; not tuned.
refiner_note: Upstream InstanceDiffusion inference.py cascade defaults (fp16 weights, caption prompt, no negative prompt, 512 px). Revision resolved at first download and stored in run.json; held-out v3 pins it. Refined arms refine the SAME base image of the same scene/seed, so the refiner effect is paired.
negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, text
precision: UNet autocast float16, VAE float32; refiner float16 (diffusers upcasts the SDXL VAE for decode)
decision_rules: Unit: 16 scene/seed pairs. Bobby delegated review: the analyst (Claude) reviews the blind sheets BEFORE opening review_key.json, with the held-out criteria (count, colour, shape incl. pose/facing, position; naturalness 0/1/2), and commits the blind review before unblinding.
Automatic evidence: SAM sketch fidelity (sketch_chamfer per image, pooled facing accuracy over asymmetric instances), same metric code as held-out v2.
An arm is admissible if: structure failures <= sil_full + 1; mean sketch_chamfer <= sil_full + 0.010; pooled facing accuracy >= sil_full - 0.10. sil_full is always admissible.
Kept arm = admissible arm with the highest mean naturalness; ties (difference < 0.10) -> fewer structure failures -> earlier arm in the list (simpler).

The kept arm becomes the frozen OCSD v3 configuration for the new locked held-out v3 comparison against the original OCSD (paper_v2 tuned config), InstanceDiffusion box, ControlNet and GLIGEN. No tuning of the parser, release step or refiner strength on these scenes; no reranking, extra seeds or reruns; failed images stay in the record.
locked_note: Locked before any image with layout-only release or the refiner. sil_full equals the held-out v2 winning arm (direct_silhouette) and is regenerated here so all four arms come from one run.
